today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,149.9 on the 2026-10-22 session with 34 DTE and ATM IV 19.31%, putting the 1σ daily move at $50 (1.22%). The chain is heavily call-weighted — 264,482 call OI against 100,352 put OI for a P/C OI ratio of 0.38 — but the near-spot ceiling has tightened to the $4,200 call strike, now 3,544 contracts. Support stacks at the $4,100 put shelf (2,350) and the unmoved $4,000 put wall (4,696). Net GEX across ±$200 of spot is −220, so dealers are locally short gamma even though the broad ±20% chain reads +163.
five_day_thesis: The defining change over five sessions is not price — spot slipped just $20.1 from $4,170 to $4,149.9 inside a $38 range — but the collapse of the near-spot ceiling. The actionable call wall migrated down $200, from $4,400 on 10/16 to $4,200 today, as $4,200 call OI nearly doubled from 2,176 to 3,544 (+1,368, with +639 added in the last session alone). Call OI grew +7,896 chain-wide versus just +1,361 on puts, a 5.8:1 accumulation skew, yet it is being written closer to spot rather than chased higher — the signature of premium sellers pinning a range, not of a breakout being positioned for. ATM IV is effectively unchanged at 19.31% (+0.02pp over the window) and max pain has not budged from $5,500 on any of the five days, confirming a compression regime rather than a directional one. The one destabilizer: local ±$200 net GEX has been negative every session (−204 → −220, trough −244 on 10/21) with the gamma flip strike parked at $4,750–$4,800, so spot has spent the entire week below the flip where dealer hedging amplifies moves instead of damping them.

prediction: Bias mildly constructive while spot holds $4,150, with the path of least resistance a grind into the thickening $4,200 call wall — one 1σ move away — where the pain gradient and the fresh call writing both argue for stall rather than breakout. Below $4,150 the $4,100 put shelf (2,350) is first support and the week's structure turns range-bound rather than bearish. The invalidation is $4,090: with local GEX at −220 and the gamma flip $600 above market, a break there has no dealer damping between spot and the $4,000 put wall.
